title: Geothermal Energy Ordinance Extraction Schema
description:
Regulatory requirements for geothermal energy facilities.

SCOPE: Geothermal power plants, exploration wells, production/injection wells, gen-tie lines, pipelines, and commercial geothermal infrastructure.

EXCLUDE: Geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential HVAC, direct-use heating/cooling, solar, wind, biomass, and other non-geothermal technologies.

When extracting from multi-technology renewable energy ordinances, ONLY extract provisions that explicitly apply to geothermal facilities.

applies_to_geothermal.description: Does this document contain provisions regulating geothermal energy facilities?

extraction_approach.description: Which sections were extracted vs excluded. Format: 'Extracted [sections]; Excluded [sections]'

state.description: US state name or abbreviation exactly as written.

subdivision.description: Sub-jurisdiction if applicable. Null if county-level.

jurisdiction_type.description: Type: County, City, Town, Township, Borough, or Village.

year.description: Year adopted or last amended. Null if not stated.

source.description: URL or document reference. Use the SOURCE_URL from the CONTEXT block at the top of the document if present.

requirements.description:
Regulatory requirements for geothermal facilities.

EXTRACTION RULES:
(1) One row per requirement. Separate rows for different subjects/boundaries.
(2) Ranges: populate min_dist/max_dist and use range string as value.
(3) Day/night noise: separate rows with adder='daytime'/'nighttime'.
(4) PRIORITY FEATURES: property lines distance, residential zones distance, hospitals distance, schools distance, water bodies distance, roads distance, active faults distance, noise, fencing, minimum lot size, height limit, bond requirement, decommissioning, required permits, seismic monitoring, drilling hours.

feature.description: Standardized feature name for cross-jurisdiction comparison.

value.description: Primary quantifiable value. Numbers without units. Ranges as string. Null if procedural.

adder.description: Zone-specific or conditional context (e.g., 'exploration wells', 'power plant', 'within 1/2 mile of residence'). Null if general.

min_dist.description: Minimum distance when value is a range. Null if not a range.

max_dist.description: Maximum distance when value is a range. Null if not a range.

summary.description: Verbatim or closely paraphrased ordinance text supporting this requirement.

notes.description: Additional context: measurement conditions, exceptions, cross-references.
